high_level_description: The image shows an arcade machine with the iconic Atari logo prominently displayed on the top of the cabinet. The screen of the arcade machine is illuminated, displaying a scene from a fighting game. Two characters are engaged in combat, with one character appearing to be delivering a punch or kick to the other. The game interface includes various elements such as scores, time remaining (60 seconds), and credits (99). The arcade machine has a dark background, which contrasts with the bright screen and the blue neon light running along the side of the cabinet.
